segments.source: $f\im(S)$ is the image of $f \colon X \to Y$ for $S \subseteq X$.
segments.translation: $f\im(S)$는 $S \subseteq X$일 때 $f \colon X \to Y$에 의한 상입니다.

segments.source: $f\inv(y)$ is the inverse for $f \colon X \to Y$ when $y \in Y$.
$f\pre(T)$ is the pre-image for $f \colon X \to Y$ when $T \subseteq Y$.
$f \restrict{S}$ is the restriction of $f \colon X \to Y$ to $S \subseteq X$.
Below are some common sets. These may also be thought of as groups, rings, fields etc.\ in the obvious way.
segments.translation: 아래는 몇 가지 흔한 집합입니다. 이들은 자명한 방식으로 군, 환, 체 등으로도 생각할 수 있습니다.
집합에 관한 몇 가지 흔한 표기법:

segments.source: $S \times T$: Cartesian product of sets $S$ and $T$
$S / {\sim}$: if $\sim$ is an equivalence relation on $S$, this is the set of equivalence classes
segments.translation: $S / {\sim}$: $\sim$가 $S$ 위의 동치 관계라면, 이는 동치류들의 집합입니다.

segments.source: $x + S$: denotes the set $\{x+s \mid s \in S\}$.
$\Zm n$: set of units of $\Zc n$.
$G/N$: quotient group of $G$ by the normal subgroup $N$
$G \oplus H$: also product group, but often used when $G$ and $H$ are abelian (and hence we can think of them as $\ZZ$-modules)
segments.translation: $G \oplus H$: 이 또한 곱군이지만, $G$와 $H$가 아벨 군일 때(따라서 이들을 $\ZZ$-가군으로 생각할 수 있을 때) 자주 사용됩니다.

segments.source: $\Stab_G(x)$: the stabilizer of $x \in X$, if $X$ is acted on by $G$
segments.translation: $\Stab_G(x)$: $X$가 $G$의 작용을 받는 경우, $x \in X$의 안정화 부분군

segments.source: $\FixPt g$, the set of fixed points by $g \in G$ (under a group action)
segments.translation: $\FixPt g$, (군의 작용 아래) $g \in G$에 의한 고정점들의 집합

segments.source: $R[x_1, \dots, x_n]$: polynomial ring in $x_i$, or ring obtained by adjoining the $x_i$ to $R$
segments.translation: $R[x_1, \dots, x_n]$: $x_i$들에 대한 다항식환, 즉 $R$에 $x_i$들을 첨가하여 얻은 환

segments.source: $F(x_1, \dots, x_n)$: field obtained by adjoining $x_i$ to $F$
$\ket{\psi}$: a vector in some vector space $H$
$\bra{\psi}$: a vector in some vector space $H^\vee$, dual to $\ket{\psi}$.
$\braket{\phi|\psi}$: evaluation of an element $\bra{\phi} \in H^\vee$ at $\ket{\psi} \in H$.
$\partial Y$: boundary of a set $Y$ (in some topological space)
segments.translation: $\partial Y$: (어떤 위상 공간 안에서) 집합 $Y$의 경계

segments.source: $X \times Y$: product topology of spaces $X$ and $Y$
$X \amalg Y$: disjoint union of spaces $X$ and $Y$
$X \vee Y$: wedge product of (pointed) spaces $X$ and $Y$
$\int_a^b f(x) \; dx$: Riemann integral of $f$ on $[a,b]$
$\int_\alpha f \; dz$: contour integral of $f$ along path $\alpha$
segments.translation: $\int_\alpha f \; dz$: 경로 $\alpha$를 따른 $f$의 경로 적분

segments.source: $\Res(f;p)$: the residue of a meromorphic function $f$ at point $p$
$\int_\Omega f \; d\mu$: the Lebesgue integral of $f$
$\alpha \simeq \beta$: for paths, this indicates path homotopy
segments.translation: $\alpha \simeq \beta$: 경로에 대해, 이는 경로 호모토피를 나타냄

segments.source: $\pi_1(X) = \pi_1(X, x_0)$: the fundamental group of (pointed) space $X$
$\pi_n(X) = \pi_n(X, x_0)$: the $n$th homotopy group of (pointed) space $X$
$f_\sharp$: the induced map $\pi_1(X) \to \pi_1(Y)$ of $f \colon X \to Y$
$H_n(A_\bullet)$: the $n$th homology group of the chain complex $A_\bullet$
$H_n(X)$: the $n$th homology group of a space $X$
$\wt H_n(X)$: the $n$th reduced homology group of $X$
$H_n(X, A)$: the $n$th relative homology group of $X$ and $A \subseteq X$
$f_\ast$: the induced map on $H_n(A_\bullet) \to H_n(B_\bullet)$ of $f \colon A_\bullet \to B_\bullet$, or $H_n(X) \to H_n(Y)$ for $f \colon X \to Y$
segments.translation: $f_\ast$: $f \colon A_\bullet \to B_\bullet$에 의한 $H_n(A_\bullet) \to H_n(B_\bullet)$ 위의 유도 사상, 또는 $f \colon X \to Y$에 대한 $H_n(X) \to H_n(Y)$

segments.source: $H^n(A^\bullet)$: the $n$th cohomology group of a cochain complex $A^\bullet$
$H^n(A_\bullet; G)$: the $n$th cohomology group of the cochain complex obtained by applying $\Hom(-,G)$ to $A_\bullet$
segments.translation: $H^n(A_\bullet; G)$: $A_\bullet$에 $\Hom(-,G)$를 적용하여 얻은 코사슬 복합체의 $n$번째 코호몰로지 군

segments.source: $H^n(X; G)$: the $n$th cohomology group/ring of $X$ with $G$-coefficients
$\wt H^n(X; G)$: the $n$th reduced cohomology group/ring of $X$ with $G$-coefficients
segments.translation: $\wt H^n(X; G)$: $G$-계수를 갖는 $X$의 $n$번째 축소 코호몰로지 군/환

segments.source: $H^n(X,A ; G)$: the $n$th relative cohomology group/ring of $X$ and $A \subset X$ with $G$-coefficients
segments.translation: $H^n(X,A ; G)$: $G$-계수를 갖는 $X$와 $A \subset X$의 $n$번째 상대 코호몰로지 군/환

segments.source: $f^\sharp$: the induced map on $H^n(A^\bullet) \to H^n(B^\bullet)$ of $f \colon A^\bullet \to B^\bullet$, or $H^n(X) \to H^n(Y)$ for $f \colon X \to Y$
segments.translation: $f^\sharp$: $f \colon A^\bullet \to B^\bullet$에 의한 $H^n(A^\bullet) \to H^n(B^\bullet)$ 위의 유도 사상, 또는 $f \colon X \to Y$에 대한 $H^n(X) \to H^n(Y)$

segments.source: $\catname{hTop}$: category of topological spaces, whose morphisms are homotopy classes of maps
segments.translation: $\catname{hTop}$: 위상 공간의 범주로, 그 사상은 사상들의 호모토피 류입니다

segments.source: $\catname{hPairTop}$: category of pairs $(X,A)$ with morphisms being pair-homotopy equivalence classes
$\Opens(X)$: the category of open sets of $X$, as a poset
$\ker f \colon \Ker f \to B$: for $f \colon A \to B$, categorical kernel
segments.translation: $\ker f \colon \Ker f \to B$: $f \colon A \to B$에 대해, 범주론적 핵

segments.source: $\coker f \colon A \to \Coker f$: for $f \colon A \to B$, categorical cokernel
segments.translation: $\coker f \colon A \to \Coker f$: $f \colon A \to B$에 대한 범주론적 여핵

segments.source: $\img f \colon A \to \Img f$: for $f \colon A \to B$, categorical image
segments.translation: $\img f \colon A \to \Img f$: $f \colon A \to B$에 대한 범주론적 상

segments.source: $\int_c \alpha$: integration of the differential form $\alpha$ over a cell $c$
$\ol F$: algebraic closure of a field $F$
$\ka\kb$: ideal generated by products of elements in ideals $\ka$ and $\kb$
$\ka\inv$: the inverse of $\ka$ in the ideal group
$\mu(\OO_K)$: set of roots of unity contained in $\OO_K$
$\Aut(K/F)$: set of field automorphisms of $K$ fixing $F$
$P_K(\km)$: ray of principal ideals of a modulus $\km$
$C_K(\km)$: ray class group of a modulus $\km$
$V \oplus W$: direct sum of representations $V = (V, \rho_V)$ and $W = (W, \rho_W)$ of an algebra $A$
$\Homrep(V,W)$: algebra of morphisms $V \to W$ of representations
$\chi_V$: the character $A \to k$ attached to an $A$-representation $V$
$\FunCl(G)$: the complex vector space of functions $\Classes(G) \to \CC$
$V \otimes W$: tensor product of representations $V = (V, \rho_V)$ and $W = (W, \rho_W)$ of a \emph{group} $G$ (rather than an algebra)
$\VV(-)$: vanishing locus of a set or ideal
$\CC[V]$: coordinate ring of an affine variety $V$
$\CP^n$: complex projective $n$-space (ambient space for projective varieties)
$h_I$, $h_V$: Hilbert function of an ideal $I$ or projective variety $V$
segments.translation: $h_I$, $h_V$: 아이디얼 $I$ 또는 사영 다양체 $V$의 힐베르트 함수

segments.source: $\pi^\sharp$ or $\pi^\sharp_U$: the pullback $\OO_Y \to \OO_X(\pi\pre(U))$ obtained from $\pi \colon X \to Y$
$\SF_p$: the stalk of a (pre-)sheaf $\SF$ at a point $p$
$[s]_p:$ the germ of $s \in \SF(U)$ at the point $p$
$\Spec A$: the spectrum of a ring $A$
$S\inv A$: localization of ring $A$ at a set $S$
$A[1/f]$: localization of ring $A$ away from element $f$
$A_\kp$: localization of ring $A$ at prime ideal $\kp$
$\kappa(\kp)$: the residue field of $\Spec A$ at the element $\kp$.
$\pi^\sharp_{\kp}$: the induced map of stalks in $\pi^\sharp$.
$\ZFC^+$: standard theory of ZFC, plus the sentence ``there exists a strongly inaccessible cardinal''
segments.translation: $\ZFC^+$: 표준적인 ZFC 이론에 ``강한 비가측 기수가 존재한다''라는 문장을 추가한 것입니다.

segments.source: $V$: class of all sets (von Neumann universe)
$\omega$: the first infinite ordinal, also the set of nonnegative integers
segments.translation: $\omega$: 첫 번째 무한 순서수이며, 음이 아닌 정수 전체의 집합이기도 합니다.

segments.source: $V_\alpha$: level of the von Neumann universe
$\bigcup A$: the union of elements inside $A$
$\MM \vDash \phi[b_1, \dots, b_n]$: model $\MM$ satisfies sentence $\phi$ with parameters $b_1$, \dots, $b_n$
segments.translation: $\MM \vDash \phi[b_1, \dots, b_n]$: 모델 $\MM$이 매개변수 $b_1$, \dots, $b_n$을 가진 문장 $\phi$를 만족합니다

segments.source: $p \parallel q$: elements $p$ and $q$ of a poset $\Po$ are compatible
$p \perp q$: elements $p$ and $q$ of a poset $\Po$ are incompatible
$\tau^G$: interpretation of a name $\tau$ by filter $G$
$M[G]$: the model obtained from a forcing poset $G \subseteq \Po$
$\check x$: the name giving an $x \in M$ when interpreted
segments.translation: $\check x$: 해석되었을 때 $x \in M$을 주는 이름

segments.source: $\dot G$: the name giving $G$ when interpreted
